'''Aleos Narek's shop''' was a store on [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] that was previously owned by the father of [[Aleos Narek's wife]]. When [[Aleos Narek]] married her, they commandeered the shop together and had [[Aleos Narek's son|chil]][[Aleos Narek's daughter|dren]].

==History==
Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Aleos Narek's shop closed down because the 2 owners [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[bombing of Rialla Way]].<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />
